runtime.execution: Synchronous role/phase loop, model text commands, fresh multiprocessing child for each generated-code execution.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns report/code/phase-object snapshots and code children; consumes model SDKs/search. No shared kernel/database service is present in traced execution.

summary: Role-based research phases refine experiment code with execution feedback and model reward before report review.

inspection.scope: phase scheduler/model dispatch/command parser, code worker and timeout, history expiry, object snapshots and review/human feedback
inspection.limits: No first-party test suite found in inspected file inventory; application UI/AgentRxiv service not fully traced. Source only, no provider/code/PDF execution.

actions.name: LaboratoryWorkflow.perform_research / set_model / save_state
actions.input: Research topic, phase map/limits, role notes and optional human-loop flags.
actions.output: Phase products/status/stats and overwritten PaperN.pkl snapshot.
actions.lifecycle: Sequential phases with repeat/refinement backedges; model activation at subtask boundary.
actions.authority: Host configures roles/providers and trusted snapshot serialization.

actions.name: REPLACE / EDIT
actions.input: Entire fenced Python candidate or inclusive line range/new lines.
actions.lifecycle: Executes dataset+candidate in fresh child before acceptance; failed text candidate reverted, external side effects not rolled back.
actions.authority: Child host OS authority; no true process sandbox in traced runner.

actions.name: execute_code
actions.output: Captured stdout/traceback or timeout error string.
actions.lifecycle: Fresh multiprocessing child; direct terminate after join timeout; no durable handle.
actions.authority: Operator/runtime host account; substring prohibitions are not comprehensive isolation.

actions.name: get_score / ReviewersAgent.inference / report_refinement
actions.input: Plan/code/output or plan/report and configured reward/reviewer model.
actions.output: Model score/persona reviews and loop-repeat decision.
actions.lifecycle: Synchronous model calls; fixed override may end review regardless of findings.
actions.authority: Authored model judgement over artifact text, not independent rerun oracle.

actions.name: human_in_loop
actions.input: Phase product and user Y/N plus rejection notes.
actions.output: Accept or reset histories/repeat phase with notes.
actions.lifecycle: Phase boundary only; not live provider steering.

filesystem.detail: Generated experiment code/output/report files and overwritten pickle workflow snapshots are owned by host; arbitrary generated Python can access host files with child OS authority.

processes.detail: Fresh child per code execution; timeout terminates direct process. No durable job ID, process-group descendant proof or shared external execution service appears.

code_actions.detail: Fenced REPLACE and EDIT inclusive-line commands form actual executable coding actions; candidate code runs before acceptance, repairs have bounded retries and rollback only covers text candidate.

persistent_kernel.detail: Each execution starts fresh globals/process; persistent model/workflow objects and dataset_code string are not a persistent scientific namespace.

standing_database.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected phase scheduler/model dispatch/command parser, code worker and timeout, history expiry, object snapshots and review/human feedback; no universal absence claim.

workflow_programming.detail: Fixed phase scheduler and configurable per-phase model/notes/human feedback steer research; editing experiment programs does not expose arbitrary turn/workflow graph programming.

multi_model.detail: Per-phase model map selects provider/model at subtask boundary; role agents and reviewers may change model through host. Three reviewer personas are same configured model, not independent peers.

live_collaboration.detail: Role prompts exchange shared attributes and human phase feedback in the authored workflow; inspected paths provide no addressed asynchronous peer messages or busy-target delivery.

concurrent_work.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected phase scheduler/model dispatch/command parser, code worker and timeout, history expiry, object snapshots and review/human feedback; no universal absence claim.

steering_interrupt.detail: Human rejection repeats phase with new notes after phase product; code execution has timeout. No in-flight provider abort/steer contract was traced.

turn_redefinition.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected phase scheduler/model dispatch/command parser, code worker and timeout, history expiry, object snapshots and review/human feedback; no universal absence claim.

compaction.detail: Context history expires selected feedback or drops oldest at max length; prior content is not archived by that transformation.

context_repair.detail: Phase rejection clears role histories and adds feedback; experiment repair edits code. Neither operation retrieves originals to repair lost active conversation.

original_audit.detail: Phase objects, code/output logs and latest workflow pickle preserve selected state. Expired history and overwritten files/snapshot lose originals; no all-IO audit.

audit_query.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected phase scheduler/model dispatch/command parser, code worker and timeout, history expiry, object snapshots and review/human feedback; no universal absence claim.

hot_change.detail: Per-phase model updates and candidate experiment code take effect within workflow; no harness executable refit or arbitrary hot engine reload is shown.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Latest pickled phase state is a checkpoint primitive; inspected saves do not supply a resume loader, active-call/process continuity, executable rebuild or re-inhabitation.

remote_services.detail: Direct model SDK requests consume chosen providers; local code children are owned. Search roles exist separately, no remote shared kernel control plane inferred.

self_improvement.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected phase scheduler/model dispatch/command parser, code worker and timeout, history expiry, object snapshots and review/human feedback; no universal absence claim.

complaints.detail: Not established in the explicitly inspected phase scheduler/model dispatch/command parser, code worker and timeout, history expiry, object snapshots and review/human feedback; no universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Generated code runs under child host authority with substring filters for exit/pubmed; optional human review is phase-level and direct model SDK branches modify process environment credentials.

evaluation.detail: Code acceptance checks error substring; reward is parsed LLM score over plan/code/output, three report reviewers are persona calls to same model. This evaluates research artifacts, not independent scientific truth or harness self-improvement.

time_order.detail: Sequential phase/step/history and process join timeout establish local order; snapshot lacks immutable run/attempt event identities.

evidence.claim: Fixed phases map to model names and role agents; save_state overwrites one pickled workflow object per paper.
Research traverses phase/subtask loops, changes models at boundaries, preserves phase_status and can recursively reset experiment phases after refinement.
Agent rebuilds prompt from phase/context/history/notes, calls query_model, tracks response and drops expired/old history entries at bounded length.
Provider branches construct SDK requests from system/prompt, retry, select OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic and set global environment credentials.
REPLACE parses fenced code and executes dataset+new code before accepting text as candidate.
EDIT parses inclusive line range, splices candidate and executes dataset+new code; substring execution error is rejection oracle.
Reward model reads plan/code/output and emits a SCORE float; validity is parsed model output rather than independently measured objective.
Command dispatch tests edits, repairs up to fixed attempts and rolls back candidate code on failure; successful code gets model score.
Code executes in fresh multiprocessing globals, captured stdout queue; timeout terminates direct process, not proven descendant group; simple substring filters are no sandbox.
Report refinement reads three reviewer outputs and either bounded override or model decision returns to planning; optional human branch has distinct behavior.
Three reviewers are sequential persona prompts to same configured model over plan/report.
Human phase rejection resets agents, records notes and repeats phase; no live provider interrupt handle supplied.
Best experiment code/output written to deliverable files after solver iterations; selecting best score is model-reward based.

strengths: Concrete staged research loop and experiment candidate rollback/feedback mechanics.
Configurable model roles and human phase review are visible rather than marketing-only.
limits: Text rollback does not undo generated program effects.
Same-model reward/persona review is not independent evaluation.
Fresh process execution, destructive history expiry and overwritten pickle are weak continuity/audit.
arconaut_questions: How can research-program candidate evaluation avoid conflating no traceback with validity?
What independent task oracle and retained original execution evidence should govern autoresearch?
